primary_metric: official Total pooled over the outer folds
treatment: append the 54-column geom__ plane-fit spatial-gradient block (d/dx, d/dy, |grad| per source-variable plus divergence and vorticity for the wind pairs) to the frozen 100 selected M115 features
control: M115_REFIT_ZERO, the identical refit with the frozen 100 features only
deployment_rule: CHAMPION + (0.70/3) * (arm - control), clipped to [0, 1.075*capacity]; Q2 is burn-in and is set to CHAMPION
falsifier: pooled outer Total delta versus M115_REFIT_ZERO below +0.001, or a sign reversal across the two outer folds
disclosure: An identical exploratory run was executed before this predeclaration and is recorded at reports/s17_n37_exploratory_prepredeclaration_run.json. This predeclared execution is deterministic and must reproduce it exactly; the comparison is admitted only on that reproduction.
